verdict.rationale: monday.com documents native tooling for building and configuring custom AI agents: defining goals/rules, natural-language creation ('Describe any workflow... to create a unique agent'), scoped board access, secret storage, event subscriptions, and admin oversight dashboards. This directly matches the story of an AI-native user building/configuring their own agent within the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the agent-builder UX and no clarity on limits of customization depth beyond marketing copy.
